overall.headline: Global EFB and Flight Planning Selections Show Diverse Carrier and Fleet Adoption Patterns
observations: Across **519** total airlines, **127** recorded EFB selections led by **AvioBook** at **21** of **127** and **In-house built** at **19** of **127**.
For flight planning, **68** airlines recorded selections, with **Lido** capturing **24** of **68** and **NavBlue** capturing **16** of **68**.
Flag carriers and low-cost carriers display distinct platform preferences across varying fleet sizes, highlighting segmented operational strategies globally.
overall.caveat: Counts represent recorded selections rather than absolute market share, and missing fields indicate unrecorded data rather than non-adoption.

regions.name: Europe & Central Asia
regions.headline: Europe & Central Asia Shows Strong In-House and AvioBook EFB Adoption alongside Lido Planning
observations: Among **151** airlines with **35** EFB-recorded entries, **In-house built** leads with **7** of **35** and **AvioBook** with **6** of **35**.
For flight planning, **14** airlines recorded selections, where **Lido** accounts for **5** of **14** and **FlightKeys** for **4** of **14**.
Check event audience and agenda before committing to future research here.
regions.caveat: Selections reflect recorded Airtable entries only; unrecorded fields are unknown.

observations: Out of **130** airlines with **39** EFB recordings, **In-house built** reaches **9** of **39** while **Paper** records **6** of **39**.

Review local event agendas and audience composition prior to event research.
